Dear Miss Yonge	
[I](../persons.html#939) quite hope to write to you about the [Bethlehem](../others.html#177) this week. I have the duplicates, but have not got time to read them at a sitting as I meant.

Will you kindly send the Cawnpore [notice](../books.html#59) to me. [Mr Trevelyan](../persons.html#1943) has just been in.

He was much gratified by your estimate of his book.[^1] For long your books and name have been familiar and dear in their family.

Yours ever faithfully
A.

Macmillan

[^1]: CMY had written a review for [Macmillan\'s Magazine](../others.html#78) of George Otto Trevelyan\'s book on the massacre at Cawnpore during the [[other:]Indian Mutiny].
